name: GALA PRECISION ENG LTD
summary: Gala Precision Engineering Limited manufactures and sells precision components in India and internationally. The company offers disc, strip, coil, and spiral springs; and high tensile fasteners, such as studs, anchor bolts, cross bolts, flange nuts and hex nuts, Gallock wedge lock washers, and grip lock washers for wind turbines, hydro plants, railways, off-highway equipment, and infrastructure. It serves its products to OEMs, tier-1 and channel partners in various industries, including renewable energy, industrials, and mobility. Gala Precision Engineering Limited was founded in 1989 and is based in Thane, India.
